items.title: Insights, your way
items.body: Pick what matters most (strength, muscle, weight loss, endurance, mind or your sport) and Insights opens on it. Switch any time.

items.title: Ask Coach about your training
items.body: A clearer ask bar on Insights with one-tap BEST, COMPARE, COUNT and VOLUME questions.

items.title: Coach in Add exercises
items.body: Ask Coach or snap your machine right from Add exercises: Coach's picks tick straight into your list.

items.title: Fuel follows skips
items.body: Skip a workout and Fuel, the Calendar widget and Home Screen week dots treat the day as a rest day.

items.title: Safer and steadier
items.body: Security fixes and a stronger server keep your data safe and the app fast.
